entities.name: Raghib
entities.description: Fellow student and one-time lover of Nailah on Rabiah, used by her and later allied with the white Taysir.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: Planeswalker on Rabiah who sought the power of the unified Taysir and killed Raghib.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Planeswalker of Rabiah existing as five different versions (white, red, black, green, blue) who united to defeat Nailah.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Plane where Raghib and Nailah studied.

entities.name: Unification of Taysir
entities.description: Nailah's scheme to merge the five Taysirs into a single, most powerful planeswalker.

events.summary: Nailah uses Raghib to gather objects such as the Ring of Ma'rûf, then curses him as a leper when he is no longer useful.
events.quote: Nailah used Raghib to gather various objects she needed, such as the Ring of Ma'rûf

events.summary: Raghib tracks down the white Taysir and stays at his side.
events.quote: He tracked down the white Taysir and stayed at his side.

events.summary: Raghib reveals his true identity to Taysir.
events.quote: Raghib revealed his true identity to Taysir

events.summary: Nailah kills Raghib with a drain spell moments before the united Taysirs defeat her.
events.quote: his former lover had killed him moments before with a drain spell

relations.quote: was the fellow student and one time lover of Nailah

relations.note: Killed him with a drain spell.

relations.note: Stayed at the white Taysir's side.
